blocks.html:
This method creates a product category. It sends a request to the
[Create Category](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-categories\_postproductcategories)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the category to create.

children.name: name
children.description: The product category's name.

children.name: description
children.description: The product category's description.

children.name: handle
children.description:
The product category's unique handle. Can be used to create
human-readable URLs.

children.name: is_internal
children.description:
Whether the category is only available and viewable by
admin users.

children.name: is_active
children.description:
Whether the category is active. If disabled, the category
isn't retrieved in the store API routes.

children.name: parent_category_id
children.description: The ID of the parent category.

children.name: rank
children.description: The category's ranking among its sibling categories.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An external identifier for the product category.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the category.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: include_ancestors_tree
children.description:
Whether to retrieve the parent category. If enabled, the parent category is
retrieved in the `parent_category` field.

children.name: include_descendants_tree
children.description:
Whether to retrieve the child categories. If enabled, the child categories are
retrieved in the `category_children` field.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: product_category
children.description: The category's details.

children.name: category_children
children.description: The category's children.

children.name: parent_category
children.description: The parent category's details.

children.name: products
children.description: The products that belong to this category.

children.name: translations
children.description: The category's translations.

children.name: id
children.description: The category's ID.

children.name: name
children.description: The category's name.

children.name: description
children.description: The category's description.

children.name: handle
children.description:
The product category's unique handle. Can be used to create
human-readable URLs.

children.name: is_active
children.description: Whether the category is active.

children.name: is_internal
children.description: Whether the category is internal.

children.name: rank
children.description: The category's ranking among sibling categories.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An external identifier for the product category.

children.name: parent_category_id
children.description: The ID of the category's parent.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the category was created.

children.name: updated_at

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the category was deleted.
